away.summary: The Golden Knights (9-5-2) are projected to start Adin Hill in net after Carter Hart made 25 saves in a 3-2 shootout loss to the Boston Bruins on Monday. The projected lineup includes Mitch Marner on the second line with William Karlsson and Brett Howden, while Raphael Lavoie and Viliam Kmec are scratched. Victor Olofsson and Parker Wotherspoon are out with injuries.

out.detail: lower body injury, day to day

home.summary: The Penguins (5-7-2) are projected to start Arturs Silovs in goal, with Sergei Murashov listed as the backup. Evgeni Malkin will not play despite participating in an optional morning skate and is day to day with a lower-body injury. Kaedan Korczak is a game-time decision, while Justin Brazeau could make his season debut after returning from a conditioning loan.
